project_shell.source: artifact/index.html and artifact/assets/app.js, derived from woodpecker-functional-prototype-with-ops
required_elements: route-level page headers, actions, tabs, cards, tables and state regions
omitted_elements: locale switcher; the approved prototype is Simplified Chinese and production locale behavior is verified separately

screens: all 67 documented routes and tab states
fields: repository, pipeline, branch, pull request and setting fields
server, server group, service, metric and alert fields
application, environment, release, deployment, approval and policy fields
organization, administration, agent, queue, forge and user setting fields
actions: navigation, search, filter, theme, create, update, delete and copy
pipeline run, approve, decline, cancel, retry, debug and deploy
maintenance, restart, alert acknowledge/resolve and server registration
deployment create, approve, reject, pause, resume, advance, retry and rollback

unsupported_capabilities: real SSH, Docker, Kubernetes or systemd execution
real mTLS, task signing, certificate rotation and approval services
